capabilities: fetch RSS, URL, GitHub, and Hacker News sources into a normalized candidate pool
filter candidates by freshness, quality gates, and topic keywords
write a daily Markdown draft with sections, signals, and failure records
score candidates with an Anthropic-compatible model and keep top unique events
apply external writer-output.json drafts from a compatible companion skill
disambiguation: Runs are manual and Desktop-only; the draft is a labeled candidate pool for later selection, not a final curated report.
extras: Desktop-only and manual with no scheduling or publishing; the plugin is unreviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README references local development paths and companion files (skills/trending-radar-writer, THIRD-PARTY-SOURCES.md) in an external toolkit repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect trending tech news from multiple feeds into an auditable daily report with preserved source evidence and failure records.

requires.name: Anthropic-compatible API key for AI ranking

summary: Manually run trend radar that fetches RSS, GitHub, and Hacker News sources, filters and dedupes items, and writes a daily Markdown candidate-pool draft.
